mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: CountryCodeMapper.selectCountryCodeCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_countrycode t1 WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CountryCodeMapper.selectCountryCodeList */ t1.cntry_cd , t1.cntry_nm , t1.cntry_eng_nm , t1.cntry_numb , t1.cntry_alpha3 , t1.cntry_alpha2 , t1.cntry_data_sttus_mtcd , cd1.mtcd_nm AS cntry_data_sttus_mtcd_nm , t1.cntry_regr_id , t1.cntry_regr_nm , to_char(t1.cntry_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS cntry_reg_dt , t1.cntry_amdr_id , t1.cntry_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.cntry_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS cntry_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_countrycode t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code cd1 ON cd1.mtcd = t1.cntry_data_sttus_mtcd AND cd1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: CountryCodeMapper.selectCountryCode */ t1.cntry_cd , t1.cntry_nm , t1.cntry_eng_nm , t1.cntry_numb , t1.cntry_alpha3 , t1.cntry_alpha2 , t1.cntry_data_sttus_mtcd , t1.cntry_regr_id , t1.cntry_regr_nm , to_char(t1.cntry_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS cntry_reg_dt , t1.cntry_amdr_id , t1.cntry_amdr_nm , to_char(t1.cntry_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS cntry_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_countrycode t1 WHERE t1.cntry_cd = #{cntryCd}
